method: Exact byte signature relocation in supplied USA Rev2 ROM; USA1 disassembly used as navigation only. No ROM assets exported.

occupiedMotionEnable.meaning: properties bit2 is shifted into movement-enable bit64 when the cannon becomes ready while occupied.

rightBound.meaning: low byte of packed bounds added to the saved spawn coordinate.

leftBound.meaning: high byte of packed bounds subtracted from the saved spawn coordinate.

motionAxisSelector.meaning: property bit8 selects the motion axis during initialization.

boundedConclusion: The occupied-enable operation and signed-bound arithmetic are present in Rev2. Imported per-spawn values drive the browser movement. Full per-frame state timing and post-shot motion remain adapted.
